g.text: US-14: Evidence Panel - Why the Alert Fired, Assembled from All Three Stores
Operator opens the evidence panel for a COMPOSITE alert.
API fetches from all three stores in parallel
{ lat, lon, timestamp_ms } or nil (still dark)
Each store answers a different question:
Redis: "Is the entity still dark right now?"
TSDB: "What rule fired and what were the thresholds?"
Neo4j: "Is this proximity entity known or unrelated?"
No single store answers all three.
